methods.identity: Literal own item code and same official name/state/nation; country-pass type/scope gates retained; v4 exact QID/name/state/country tie, no point used as identity proof. All baseline unresolved keys conservatively held; no identity events added.
methods.geometry: Original valid polygon or make_valid polygon components with geodesic repair area change and official-area discrepancy both <=2%; distances use densified edges <=0.0005 degrees and old-point-centred AEQD. Hold <=501m for 1m threshold uncertainty.
methods.point: Canadian otherwise-admissible outside candidates held because publisher representative points could not be verified (GeoSuite HTTP403). Official supplied point preferred (ONS BUA22 LONG/LAT; NRS 2020 centroid layers). Otherwise native-CRS polygon point-on-surface, explicitly labelled. Rounded 8 decimals must be strictly inside in native and WGS84 CRS.
methods.archive: Publisher boundary files and original Wikidata captures retained and hash-verified, not claimed newly retrieved. Original source dates/licences/editions preserved.
methods.attribution: Based on Australian Bureau of Statistics data, ABS 2021 SAL/UCL ASGS Edition 3, CC BY 4.0. Contains ONS, NRS and NISRA public sector information licensed under OGL v3; Crown copyright and database rights. Statistics Canada 2021 cartographic boundaries under Open Government Licence - Canada. Wikidata identity evidence CC0. Modifications: selected representative points derived or copied; no boundaries redistributed in repository ledger. See source receipts for URLs, dates, hashes and editions.
